instruction: Teaching lab conversion from init.ifc. Open C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Archicad and use C:\Users\user\Desktop\init_plan.png and C:\Users\user\Desktop\init_section.png as references while converting it into the required two-storey teaching lab. The init file is a partial starting model that must be completed and reorganized. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc and a tab-delimited zone schedule to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.txt. Keep the shaped model envelope approximately within min 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 and max 19.0, 8.0, 6.9, with 0.5 m tolerance. The IFC must have unique GlobalId values, exactly two building storeys, exactly eight IfcSpace zones, at least eight walls, at least two slabs, and at least one roof. On the lower storey create Z01 ATRIUM 20.0 m2, Z02 LAB-1 28.0 m2, Z03 LAB-2 28.0 m2, Z04 PREP 16.0 m2, Z05 STORAGE 12.0 m2, and Z06 STAIR 12.0 m2. On the upper storey create Z07 LAB-3 28.0 m2 and Z08 SEMINAR 28.0 m2. The schedule must use headers ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area, list those rows in order, keep each area within +/-0.10 m2, and total between 171.0 and 173.0 m2. Equivalent Archicad or IFC export internals, object names, relationship structure, materials, and property sets may vary; the required result is the stated BIM model and deliverables, not a byte-for-byte copy of the teacher IFC. [Software] Launch ArchiCAD with `C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad` (adjust version/path).
